description: Header file defining the NetworkManagerTimer class and its nested class NetworkManagerTimerJob, implementing a timer utility with start, stop, and callback functionalities within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace.

classes.name: NetworkManagerTimer
classes.description: A timer utility class that manages scheduling and execution of callback functions, supporting single-shot and recurring modes.

classes.name: NetworkManagerTimerJob
classes.description: A nested class representing individual timer jobs, with comparison operators and a Timed method to invoke the parent timer's callback.

methods.name: NetworkManagerTimer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer with default interval and state.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is currently active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and revokes scheduled jobs.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with the previously set interval.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with a specified interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setSingleShot
methods.description: Sets whether the timer should run only once or repeatedly.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets the timer interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a callback function to be called on timer timeout.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Internal method invoked when the timer expires, executing the callback and managing timer state.
